title: Mark
author: Traditionally attributed to John Mark, associated with Peter's testimony.
historicalSetting: Mark presents Jesus as the powerful Son of God and suffering Servant who gives His life as a ransom.
keyVerse: Mark 10:45 — "For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
christFocus: Mark points directly to Christ as the Son of God whose authority is revealed through service, suffering, death, and resurrection.
outline: The way of the cross — Mark 8-10
